verified_candidates.title: Focus grup – un ecosistem antreprenorial competitiv
verified_candidates.observed_fact: The official ADR Sud-Vest Oltenia page reports a regional stakeholder focus group involving business, academia, enterprise associations, consultancies, public administration and RDI actors. The page states that participants highlighted development of entrepreneurial and digital competences among the key issues for the regional entrepreneurial ecosystem.
verified_candidates.claim_boundary: This is qualitative consultation context, not a representative adult/employer survey and not a prevalence estimate. It is not converted into H1-H5 numeric points and is not treated as proof from project activity.

verified_candidates.title: Programe de formare profesională – Septembrie 2026
verified_candidates.observed_fact: The official AJOFM Dambovita 2026 press-release listing exposes a new September-2026 vocational-training publication dated 02.09.2026. The controlled HTML surface used in this run does not expose the programme details, therefore no unobserved course content or numeric value is asserted.
verified_candidates.claim_boundary: Training supply is not adult/employer need prevalence, digital/AI skill-gap prevalence or causal evidence and contributes zero H1-H5 points.

verified_candidates.title: STUDIU Resurse umane pentru specializarea inteligentă – nevoile și oferta de competențe digitale în administrație și economie
verified_candidates.observed_fact: The official ADR Centru study page states that regional data were collected from local public authorities and companies regarding digitalisation and employees' digital competences, and that the collected data allowed identification of needs for improving digital competences in both public and private sectors. It also states that the study sought direct input from regional actors on needs and barriers related to digital transformation and the role of human resources.
verified_candidates.claim_boundary: This can support qualitative triangulation of H5 in Centru, but the current control readback does not establish a source-exact population prevalence estimate. Per the locked analysis plan, secondary evidence cannot alter the deterministic H1-H5 numeric order; no numeric ranking points are added.
